prompt: Create ONE polished UI design draft board for a Turkish appointment-management app, not a production screenshot. Use the reference screenshot's EXACT established visual identity: dominant cream #FFECD1, navy #001524 text, petrol #15616D group navigation and secondary controls, orange #FF7D00 ONLY the primary save button with navy text, brown #78290F notices; Unna serif ONLY the Randevu wordmark, system sans task headings and all controls. No logo symbol, no photograph, no marketing elements, no charts, no calendar, no appointment data, no shadows or nested cards. This is the next small section of the approved management shell, not a new visual world. Landscape board around 1792x1200 with a large readable desktop viewport on LEFT and a narrow MOBILE viewport on RIGHT, simple captions MASAÜSTÜ and MOBİL outside the viewports. These are TWO responsive views of ONE weekly-hours concept, not alternative designs. Desktop header Randevu and İşletme sahibi / Çıkış yap; narrow petrol labeled icon rail İşletme selected, Ekip, Hesap, Değişiklik kayıtları near bottom; cream contextual drawer İşletme with İşletme bilgileri, İşletme saatleri selected, Hizmetler, Menüyü kapat. Main working surface heading İşletme saatleri, description Haftalık açılış, kapanış ve kapalı günleri belirleyin. Short note Türkiye saati · Her gün tek aralık. A wide plain seven-row weekly editor with thin rules, columns Gün, Durum, Açılış, Kapanış. Exact days in order Pazartesi, Salı, Çarşamba, Perşembe, Cuma, Cumartesi, Pazar. Each active day has a simple UNCHECKED checkbox labeled Kapalı in Durum column and two aligned standard time inputs: Monday–Friday 09:00 and 19:00, Saturday 09:00 and 18:00. Sunday CHECKED Kapalı with time inputs absent and calm plain text Saat girişi gerekmiyor. Distinguish closure by checked box AND written text, not color alone. Readable 16px body, 48px controls, simple 6px corners, no oversized checkboxes, flat outlines. Under all seven days brown inline sentence Değişiklikler henüz kaydedilmedi. Then orange Haftayı kaydet and outlined Güncel saatleri yükle side by side. Add a tiny clearly separated scope note outside viewports TASLAK · Örnek saatler, sunucu verisi değil. On mobile, keep cream top Randevu / Menü only, sidebar closed and not visible. Heading and short description above seven daily groups. Each day has the day name on left and labeled Kapalı checkbox on right, then Açılış and Kapanış time fields side by side BELOW that row; Sunday closed no time fields. Use same example values and same order; primary save and reload buttons stack after the list, natural vertically scrolling content. Mobile viewport is shown tall enough to demonstrate all seven days and both actions, no huge whitespace. Add one small textual caption beneath desktop, outside UI: Personelde aynı düzen: seçili kişi adı, Çalışmıyor, Başlangıç / Bitiş ve Listeye dön. It describes the same editor in its existing personnel context, not a third screen or navigation feature. Do not introduce copy-to-days controls, bulk actions, new API operations, invented summaries, statistics, business photos or employee portraits. Match the approved shell and generous but efficient density; the weekly form is the dominant task. Render correct Turkish labels exactly, no browser chrome, no device frame.
